response.answer: File a policy favoring pre-recorded explainer segments with an edit pass, and permitting live radio only when it is a single-interviewer format with agreed topics. Decline multi-guest live panels, particularly where crosstalk is likely: your one such appearance produced a misquoted figure and a week of institutional credibility cleanup. This is a format-and-risk policy, not a general withdrawal from media.
